shots.name: overview
shots.alt: NOSHASHI desktop app overview, connected to XRPL mainnet, showing how much of the Bitstamp USD order book can actually fill.

shots.name: verification
shots.alt: Verification screen: a 1,000 XRP settlement to Bitstamp's account evaluated against a rule profile, with the verdict and its reasons.

shots.name: audit
shots.alt: Audit trail screen: an account's validated payment history with delivered amounts and counterparty screening.

shots.name: address
shots.alt: Address check: what an XRPL account is, who controls it and what it can do, read from the ledger.

shots.name: learn
shots.alt: Learn screen: hands-on labs that walk through the real screens with mainnet data, plus short explainers.

shots.name: control
shots.alt: Mission Control: live XRPL mainnet telemetry, ledger by ledger.

shots.name: domains
shots.alt: Domain Grid: every permissioned domain on XRPL mainnet and the credentials each requires.

shots.name: security
shots.alt: Security Center: an account check showing how an XRPL account can be taken over, read from the ledger.

shots.name: sync
shots.alt: Ledger Sync: what four public XRPL nodes each report, side by side.
